Read calibration inputs and save the optimiser control settings

read_calibration.Rd

Reads the calibration settings and observed targets with calibrar, reads the calibration parameters table, builds the objective function with make_objfn and sets up the optimiser control list. Writes the parameters to inputs/forcing.csv and the optimiser control list to inputs/control.rds.

Usage

read_calibration(
  calibration.settings,
  calibration.parameters,
  n.Cores,
  maxgen,
  master,
  run,
  restart.file,
  track.path = here::here("outputs", "keep_track_calibration"),
  REPORT = 1,
  parallel = TRUE,
  no.trace = 3,
  ...
)

Arguments

calibration.settings

Character. Pattern to match calibration settings CSV files in inputs (e.g. "calibration_settings_*.csv"), as written by make_calsettings. All matching files are read and combined. Alternatively, a single filename for backward compatibility.

calibration.parameters

Character. Name of the calibration parameters CSV file in inputs (e.g. "calibration-parameters-complete.csv"), with parameter names in the first column.

n.Cores

Integer. Number of parallel workers, also used as the population size (number of model runs per generation).

maxgen

Integer. Maximum number of generations (iterations) of the optimiser. Default: 5.

master

Character. Directory with all the files needed to run Atlantis (model files and the .sh shell script). It is copied to a run directory for each model run.

run

Character. Directory where the model runs are done.

restart.file

Character. Name of the restart file, used to restart an interrupted calibration and to save the results.

track.path

Character. Folder where the parameter files used in each run of each iteration are saved, as iteration_<iteration>/run_<run>_<file> (see keep_track_prm). Set to NULL to not save them. Default: outputs/keep_track_calibration.

...

Arguments passed to run_model through make_objfn (prefix, fg.file, biom.indx, run.prm and dt.timeseries).

Value

Invisibly, a named list with elements setup, observed, forcing, objfn (see make_objfn) and control. The control element is a list containing optimiser settings including REPORT (number of iterations before saving), parallel (logical, enable parallel computing), and trace (verbosity level for global fitness and partial fitness output). Also writes inputs/forcing.csv and inputs/control.rds.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  calibration <- read_calibration(
    calibration.settings   = "calibration_settings_*.csv",
    calibration.parameters = "calibration-parameters-complete.csv",
    n.Cores      = 32,
    master       = "model_configuration/",
    run          = "RUN",
    restart.file = "restart_file",
    prefix = "outputFolder/outputSETAS", fg.file = "SETasGroupsDem.csv",
    biom.indx = "outputFolder/outputSETASBiomIndx.txt",
    run.prm = "VMPA_setas_run_fishing_F_Trunk.prm", dt.timeseries = 5)
} # }
